name: Pan-Fried Cherry Tomatoes with Basil & Feta over Toast
ingredients: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Peel and thinly slice shallots into rings.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the shallots and cook, stirring often, until soft and caramelized, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the tomatoes; cut in half crosswise.
Add tomatoes, garlic, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until tomatoes begin to soften and juices have thickened, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add basil to the skillet and stir to combine; remove from the heat.
To serve, divide toast between plates. Spoon warm tomato mixture over the toast and top with feta. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
